Agent Name: Literature_Expert  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: Literature_Expert incorrectly identified the word "mis-transmission" as the one in the citation that does not match, without properly verifying the original text in the article. The original text contained "mistransmission" (without a hyphen), and this discrepancy was accurately flagged. However, the solution provided by Literature_Expert incorrectly claimed that "mis-transmission" was in the citation, when in fact, "mis-transmission" was the quoted text being checked. The error occurred due to a misunderstanding of which text belonged to the citation and which was the original source, leading to the wrong solution.
